name: LoomWard · 织盾

title.zh: LoomWard · 织盾 · 基于 Cordis 内核的综合本地 Agent 安全管控平台
title.en: LoomWard · Cordis-Based Local Agent Security & Control Plane

summary.zh: 基于 Cordis 4 微内核与 pnpm monorepo 构建的个人综合 Agent 管控平台，融合 Cloudflare OAuth 2.1 远程中继、本机逐参人工审批、只读 Linux Docker 沙箱、第三方 MCP 聚合、防泄漏护栏与人机决策台账。
summary.en: Cordis 4 monorepo local Agent control plane unifying Cloudflare OAuth 2.1 remote MCP relay, exact local approval, read-only Linux Docker sandboxes, third-party MCP aggregation, anti-leak guardrails, and a decision ledger.

zh: 以 Cordis 4 + 冻结根插件清单（RPM）+ KernelGuard + PolicyTree 为安全微内核，机械守卫包间分层，锁定 tool:invoke@1 单调阻断与不可替换不变量，全部扩展运行于进程外边界
物理拆分 Ring 2 独立信任面（18798 PassKey/强密码、逐参两步审批、能力熔断）与 Ring 3 只读控制台（18797 观测/SSE 与零 JS 注入声明式 console:panel@1），并预留零耦合 ContentInspect v1 审查契约
整合远程桥接、R1–R7 离线防泄漏护栏（@loomward/plugin-antileak）与人机决策台账（@loomward/plugin-decisions），并通过 @loomward/plugin-adapters 无侵入对接独立仓 CloudForge 与 ModelBridge
en: Powered by a Cordis 4 microkernel with frozen Root Plugin Manifests (RPM), KernelGuard, PolicyTree, mechanical layering checks, monotonic tool:invoke@1 safety latches, and strict out-of-process extension boundaries

Physically separates Ring 2 Trust Origin (18798 PassKey/password, two-step approval, kill switches) from Ring 3 read-only Console Origin (18797 telemetry/SSE + zero-JS declarative console:panel@1) alongside a zero-coupling ContentInspect v1 contract

Consolidates remote bridge, offline R1–R7 anti-leak guardrails (@loomward/plugin-antileak), and decision ledger (@loomward/plugin-decisions) while integrating standalone CloudForge and ModelBridge via @loomward/plugin-adapters

quickStart: pnpm run build:console && pnpm run check && pnpm run layering

milestone.zh: 已完成四阶段 Cordis 4 monorepo 重构：微内核守卫与冻结 RPM、双源物理隔离控制台、进程外防泄漏护栏与决策台账插件、独立仓 CloudForge/ModelBridge 适配及终轮对抗安全加固。
milestone.en: Completed all 4 phases of the Cordis 4 monorepo architecture: KernelGuard & frozen RPM, physical Dual-Origin Console, out-of-process antileak & decisions plugins, standalone CloudForge/ModelBridge adapters, and adversarial security hardening.
